name: GatherOS
summary: Mac app that captures design references and websites and makes them searchable in a local-first library.
description: A Mac app for collecting design inspiration: capture references by drag, paste or screenshot, sync X bookmarks, and find them again with AI visual search or search by color. Collections, infinite spaces, auto-tagging, generate variations and a rediscover mode organize the library; a Chrome extension covers the browser.
contains: capture by drag, paste or screenshot
AI visual search and search by color
local-first library with collections, infinite spaces and unlimited libraries
auto-tagging, generate variations and rediscover mode
